subject: Staged unwind tolerance & staircase waiver request for Avento (Deal AV-2027-07)
messages:
From: Matt Liu <matt.liu@avento.com>
To: rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Anne Park <anne.park@avento.com>, procure@greenlaw.com
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOW draft — unwind protections and downgrade path

Rafael — thanks for the draft. Two items procurement needs clarity on before legal signs: 1) a clear opt-out for the pilot after 6 months without penalty, and 2) staged downgrade protection so we can reduce committed capacity if usage doesn't hit agreed thresholds.

Concretely: Avento is asking for a clause that allows termination or downward adjustment with a 45-day notice after month 6, and a partial credit equal to unused committed commit for the remainder of month(s) prorated. We understand this is non-standard; please advise what concessions Redwood can offer (credits, capped liability, or a stair-stepped ramp schedule). Also attaching the SOW redlines from our side (see referenced redline in my previous email).

Deal and timeline: we need commercial terms by EOD Wednesday to include with our procurement packet.

—Matt
Matt Liu
Senior Procurement Manager, Avento Therapeutics
procurement@avento.com

From: rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Matt Liu <matt.liu@avento.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOW draft — unwind protections and downgrade path

Matt — appreciate the clarity. We can entertain a limited early-unwind / staged downgrade path for this pilot but will need executive sign-off on the economic tradeoffs. High level proposal from Redwood: 1) Pilot opt-out window: between month 7 and month 9 only (one 45-day notice window) — opt-out triggers a prorated credit equal to 50% of remaining committed spend (cap $50k). 2) Staged downgrade: allow one permanent capacity reduction (up to 50% of committed throughput) after month 6 with a 60-day notice; this triggers a one-time reprice to the standard on-demand rate plus a 10% admin fee. 3) Any opt-out/downsizing request requires 45-day notice and a final audit of usage.

These terms are narrower than your ask (we propose a credit, not full refund, and a cap) — they preserve predictability for our booking while giving Avento runway. I'm looping in Kar: can we get an approval from Deal Desk and a brief sanity check from Finance? Marissa — FYI, looking for exec OK on the concession (this is a ~$360k ARR committed seat).

If agreed, I'll send a short addendum with precise language for Legal and DocuSign.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SOW draft — unwind protections and downgrade path (Deal Desk review requested)

Marissa / Laura — forwarding Rafael's thread for Deal Desk sign-off. Quick summary / ask: Avento (Deal AV-2027-07) requests an early-unwind opt-out after month 6 and a staged downgrade option. Rafael proposes a constrained concession: a single 45-day opt-out window (months 7–9) with a 50% prorated credit capped at $50k, and one permanent downgrade up to 50% after month 6 with reprice and 10% admin fee.

Commercial impact: if exercised this reduces committed revenue by up to ~$50k — present value roughly $40k in year one; lifetime risk if precedent set could be larger. Finance has reviewed the impact model (attached). Precedent: limited — we granted a one-time pilot unwind for Nimbus in 2026 but it had stricter caps.

Recommended path: exec waiver to allow Rafael to close with the proposed caps and additions: require audit right, no retroactive refunds beyond the capped credit, and explicit limit that this concession is pilot-only (non-precedential). Legal must approve redline that includes data retention and audit hooks.

Please reply with APPROVE / DENY / APPROVE-W-CONDITIONS. If approved, we'll prepare the addendum and a Docusign envelope.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Deal Desk — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

[Attachment stub: revenue_impact_model.xlsx]

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOW draft — unwind protections and downgrade path (Deal Desk review requested)

Karthik / Rafael — APPROVE-W-CONDITIONS. I approve the concession with the following binding conditions:

- Opt-out window allowed once between months 7–9 only.
- Credit capped at $50,000 total and calculated as 50% of unused committed spend on a prorated basis; no other refunds.
- Single permanent downgrade allowed (max 50% capacity) with 60-day notice; new pricing to on-demand + 10% admin.
- Concession explicitly labeled "pilot-only; non-precedential" in the addendum.
- Legal to insert an audit clause: Redwood retains right to verify usage and deny credit if material misreporting discovered.
- Procurement must accept standard data-retention and log-audit language; no special escrow or source access.
- Deal Desk to notify Finance and Sales Ops after close; any future requests from Avento will require a formal executive review.

If Legal signs the redline with those conditions, Rafael is authorized to finalize and execute the addendum and DocuSign envelope. Laura, please handle legal redline ASAP. Rafael, please update Avento and include the cap/wording in the addendum.

Best,
Marissa Cole
VP of Sales, Redwood Inference
